Canopy · Bud Empire

Terms of use

Last updated 23 September 2026

Canopy is a work of fiction. Nothing in it is for sale, nothing real is grown or supplied, and the currency on screen is imaginary. Playing it costs nothing.

What Canopy is

Canopy: Bud Empire is a single-player idle game in which you run an invented dispensary: you plant fictional crops, staff fictional counters and serve fictional customers. It is entertainment and nothing else. It is not a guide, and it does not describe how to obtain, produce or sell any real substance.

Who it is for

Canopy is intended for adults, and asks you to confirm your age before it starts. Please do not play it if you are under the age shown on that screen or the legal adult age where you live, whichever is higher.

What it costs

Nothing. There are no purchases, no subscriptions, no advertising and no currency that can be bought with real money. Nobody can pay to progress faster, and there is nothing to spend money on.

Your save is yours, and it is fragile

Your progress lives in your browser's storage on your device. That means:

  • Clearing site data, using private browsing, uninstalling the app, or a browser or operating system reclaiming space will delete your progress permanently.
  • Progress does not follow you to another device or browser on its own.
  • There is no server-side copy, so a lost save cannot be recovered or restored by anyone.

If your progress matters to you, export a backup from Settings and keep the file somewhere safe. This is the only way to move a shop to a new device or recover from lost storage.

No warranty

Canopy is provided as is, without warranties of any kind. It may contain bugs, it may lose progress, and it may stop working after a browser or system update. To the fullest extent the law allows, the developer is not liable for any loss arising from playing it — including lost saves or lost time.

Acceptable use

Play it, enjoy it, tell people about it. Please do not present it as anything other than a game, and do not represent it as a source of real products, real advice or a real dispensary.

Ownership

The game, its artwork, its code and its writing belong to their developer. Your save file belongs to you.

Changes

These terms may change; the date at the top changes with them. Continuing to play after a change means the updated terms apply.
